svg.title: Tool use: the model asks; host code executes
svg.desc: The language model emits a tool call as text; host code validates the function, arguments, permissions, and any side-effect confirmation before execution. An agent appends the observation to state and repeats its reason-act-observe loop until a final answer or step limit.

g.text: Tool use: the model asks; host code executes
Agents repeat reason → act → observe, with validation and bounded steps.
TOOL CALL · MODEL EMITS TEXT, HOST RUNS CODE
AGENT LOOP · KEEP IT BOUNDED AND AUDITABLE
Append the observation and repeat until Final or max_steps; treat tool output as untrusted data.
